title: Zero-Overhead Introspection for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
authors_zh: Rohin Manvi、Joey Hong、Tim Seyde、Maxime Labonne、Mathias Lechner、Sergey Levine（机构：加州大学伯克利分校、MIT CSAIL、Liquid AI）
paper_type_zh: 零开销内省与自适应测试时搜索研究（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 构建同时控制答案质量、计算量和延迟的自适应并行解码系统的读者。
one_line: ZIP-RC reuses reserved logits to predict reward and remaining length without an extra inference pass, then allocates prefix-tree search by utility.
ZIP-RC 在同一次前向中预测奖励与剩余长度，并据此分配测试时搜索。
why: It makes the reward–cost estimate itself an in-model inference object instead of paying for a separate verifier pass at every search decision.
inclusion_reason: It predicts reward and remaining cost at every decoding prefix, then uses those signals to allocate branches and pruning at test time.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fixed best-of-N carries every sampled trajectory to completion, even when a prefix is likely wrong or likely to become a long latency outlier. External reward models can score completed traces, but repeated verifier calls add their own cost and usually provide only a scalar confidence rather than a prediction of both likely success and remaining work.

ZIP-RC asks whether a model can expose enough real-time reward–cost information to make branching, pruning, and stopping decisions during the same decoding process. The desired controller must assess both the distribution of final reward and the distribution of remaining tokens, because a promising trajectory can still be too expensive while a low-confidence trajectory may be worthwhile if it will finish soon.

固定的最佳候选采样会让每条轨迹都生成到结束，即使某个前缀很可能错误，或很可能成为拖慢延迟的超长离群轨迹。外部奖励模型能够给完整轨迹打分，但重复调用验证器本身会增加成本，且通常只给出标量置信度，无法同时预测成功可能性和剩余工作量。

ZIP-RC 研究模型能否在同一解码过程中暴露足够的实时奖励—成本信息，以便作出分支、剪枝和停止决策。理想控制器必须同时评估最终奖励分布和剩余 token 分布，因为一条有希望的轨迹仍可能过于昂贵，而低置信度轨迹若即将结束也可能值得保留。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper reserves a small slice of vocabulary logits and masks those tokens from normal generation. At every forward pass, the reserved logits parameterize a grid-shaped joint distribution over terminal reward and remaining generation length. The model therefore emits next-token probabilities and an auxiliary reward–cost forecast together, without a second model, an architectural branch, or an additional forward pass.

The forecast becomes a search control signal. ZIP-RC views parallel decoding as a prefix-tree meta-MDP, where a meta-action chooses which prefixes to extend, pause, prune, or duplicate. A sampling utility combines expected best reward with expected total compute and maximum sequential length; selecting the action with the best utility gives a tunable policy for accuracy, FLOPs, and wall-clock latency.

论文保留一小段词表 logit，并将这些 token 从正常生成中屏蔽。在每次前向中，保留 logit 参数化一个关于终止奖励和剩余生成长度的网格状联合分布。因此，模型在同一次计算中同时输出下一个 token 概率和辅助的奖励—成本预测，不需要第二个模型、额外结构分支或额外前向。

该预测成为搜索控制信号。ZIP-RC 将并行解码视作前缀树元 MDP，其中元动作选择哪些前缀继续、暂停、剪枝或复制。采样效用把期望最大奖励、期望总计算和最大顺序长度结合起来；选择效用最高的动作，便得到可调节准确率、FLOPs 和墙钟延迟的策略。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each on-policy rollout, the method labels every prefix with a verifier-derived terminal value and the number of tokens remaining to completion. It discretizes these two targets into reward and length bins, trains the reserved-logit grid with cross-entropy, and regularizes the generator toward a frozen copy of its original policy with KL divergence. The training corpus combines DeepScaleR, MATH training, and GSM8K training, producing roughly 100,000 labeled rollouts across the reported models.

At inference, the prefix-tree state stores all generated prefixes. The controller evaluates candidate multisets of prefixes with a utility based on the joint predictions, including planned per-prefix pruning horizons; it then extends only the chosen prefixes. Experiments use Qwen3-1.7B, LFM2-1.2B Math, and LFM2-350M Math on AIME 2024, AMC 2023, MATH-500, GSM8K, and a mixed-difficulty concatenation, comparing majority voting, length pruning, weighted best-of-N with external or self evaluation, and reward-only ZIP pruning.

对于每条在策略轨迹，方法用验证器导出的终止价值和到完成还剩多少 token 为每个前缀标注。它把两个目标离散为奖励和长度分箱，用交叉熵训练保留 logit 网格，并以同原始冻结策略的 KL 散度正则化生成器。训练语料结合 DeepScaleR、MATH 训练集和 GSM8K 训练集，在报告的模型上产生约十万条带标注轨迹。

推理时，前缀树状态保存所有已生成前缀。控制器根据联合预测评估候选前缀多重集合的效用，其中包括规划好的逐前缀剪枝时域；随后只扩展被选中的前缀。实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B、LFM2-1.2B Math 和 LFM2-350M Math，在 AIME 2024、AMC 2023、MATH-500、GSM8K 和混合难度拼接集上比较多数投票、长度剪枝、外部或自评估加权最佳候选，以及仅按奖励剪枝的 ZIP 变体。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper first checks that the in-model joint forecast is informative. At generation start, its reward–length distributions have total variation around 0.45–0.48 against 256-rollout estimates; at completion, reward prediction reaches F1 scores of 0.80–0.91 and accuracy of 0.82–0.88 across the three models. This supports using the reserved logits as a control signal rather than treating zero overhead as a purely architectural claim.

At matched generation cost and latency emphasis, ZIP-RC sampling improves Qwen3-1.7B AIME 2024 accuracy from 53.1% under majority voting to 65.8% at similar normalized cost, and improves the mixed benchmark from 91.0% to 92.2%. The paper reports analogous gains for both LFM models and smooth Pareto frontiers under compute- and latency-weighted settings. Its strongest boundary is mixed-difficulty mathematical reasoning with a trained verifier, not universal deployment without supervision.

论文先检验模型内联合预测是否有信息量。在生成开始时，其奖励—长度分布相对 256 次轨迹估计的总变差约为 0.45 至 0.48；在完成时，三个模型的奖励预测 F1 为 0.80 至 0.91，准确率为 0.82 至 0.88。这支持把保留 logit 当作控制信号，而不是把零开销仅当作架构层面的主张。

在匹配生成成本且强调延迟的设置下，ZIP-RC 采样把 Qwen3-1.7B 在 AIME 2024 上的准确率从多数投票的 53.1% 提升到 65.8%，归一化成本相近；混合基准从 91.0% 提升到 92.2%。论文报告两个 LFM 模型也有类似增益，并在计算和延迟加权设置下形成平滑帕累托前沿。其最强证据边界是带训练验证器的混合难度数学推理，而不是无监督下的普遍部署。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior pruning methods generally use a confidence scalar or a hand-written stopping rule. ZIP-RC changes the information available to inference: each prefix carries an in-model joint forecast of both outcome quality and remaining cost, allowing the controller to value branching, early finishers, and pruning in one common utility. The prediction consumes no additional model forward pass because it is encoded in otherwise reserved logits.

The paper does not claim that a frozen base model magically acquires introspection. It trains an auxiliary prediction target and relies on a learned verifier to form rollout labels. The new reusable object is therefore the reward–length prediction grid plus the policy that consumes it. Reuse should check whether reserved tokens are truly unused, whether the verifier labels match the deployment objective, and whether the chosen utility weights reflect actual parallel hardware cost.

已有剪枝方法通常使用置信度标量或手写停止规则。ZIP-RC 改变了推理可获得的信息：每个前缀都携带关于结果质量和剩余成本的模型内联合预测，使控制器能用同一个效用衡量分支、早完成轨迹和剪枝。该预测不消耗额外模型前向，因为它被编码在原本保留的 logit 中。

论文并未声称冻结的基础模型会神奇地获得内省。它训练辅助预测目标，并依赖学习到的验证器形成轨迹标签。因此新的可复用对象是奖励—长度预测网格及其消费策略。复用时应检查保留 token 是否确实未使用、验证器标签是否匹配部署目标，以及所选效用权重是否反映真实并行硬件成本。

title: Limitations
局限
html: ZIP-RC needs post-training data with verifier-derived reward labels, so its quality depends on verifier calibration and on the relation between training and deployment trajectories. The method assumes spare or reserved vocabulary logits can be masked safely and that the auxiliary loss does not materially damage generation. Its utility estimates rely on sample independence and diversity; when extra samples are highly correlated, neither best-of-N nor adaptive branching can recover much value. Finally, normalized FLOPs and best-case latency are proxies for serving cost, so a deployment must benchmark actual batching, KV-cache behavior, CPU-side utility calculation, and tail latency.

ZIP-RC 需要带有验证器导出奖励标签的后训练数据，因此其质量取决于验证器校准，以及训练轨迹与部署轨迹的关系。方法假定空闲或保留词表 logit 可以被安全屏蔽，且辅助损失不会实质损害生成。效用估计依赖样本独立性与多样性；当额外样本高度相关时，最佳候选和自适应分支都无法恢复多少价值。最后，归一化 FLOPs 与最佳情形延迟只是服务成本代理，部署必须实测实际批处理、KV 缓存行为、CPU 侧效用计算和尾部延迟。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when an inference system already runs parallel candidates but wants to avoid an external verifier pass at every token or completed trace. The reusable design is to train an in-model signal that predicts both outcome and remaining work, retain a traceable utility function, and compare quality, FLOPs, and sequential latency under matched budgets. The official repository includes an end-to-end smoke test and pipeline documentation. Before production use, calibrate the reward–length grid on the deployed model, fix the resource coefficients with measured hardware data, and log why every prefix was expanded or pruned.
当推理系统已经运行并行候选，却希望避免在每个 token 或完整轨迹上调用外部验证器时，可以使用这项工作。可复用设计是训练一个同时预测结果和剩余工作量的模型内信号，保留可追踪的效用函数，并在匹配预算下比较质量、FLOPs 和顺序延迟。官方仓库包含端到端冒烟测试和流水线文档。生产使用前，应在部署模型上校准奖励—长度网格，用实测硬件数据确定资源系数，并记录每个前缀为何被扩展或剪枝。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key distinction is between a score and a distribution: ZIP-RC needs the joint reward–length distribution to reason about the benefit of another sample and the cost of finishing it. Zero overhead applies to the additional prediction at inference, not to the required post-training or CPU search arithmetic. The most persuasive result is not a single accuracy number but the matched-cost Pareto behavior across three model sizes. Treat the ICLR status and public code as strong reproducibility signals, while still checking whether the reward verifier and vocabulary reservation are compatible with a new model family.
关键区别在于分数与分布：ZIP-RC 需要奖励—长度联合分布，才能推理再增加一个样本的收益及完成它的成本。零开销指的是推理时的额外预测，而不是所需后训练或 CPU 搜索计算。最有说服力的结果不是单个准确率数字，而是跨三个模型规模的匹配成本帕累托行为。ICLR 状态和公开代码是较强的可复现信号，但仍须检查奖励验证器和词表保留是否兼容新的模型家族。
